faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER), Puducherry, for an ICMR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Project Research Scientist - I (Medical) and Project Research Scientist - II (Non-Medical) on a contract basis under advertisement number MED/ICMR/SMART/2026/1.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Research Scientist positions in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application via email is October 15, 2026. Candidates must ensure their submissions reach on time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email to [email protected] with all necessary documents merged into a single PDF file as instructed.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Project Research Scientist - I (Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree or BDS/BAMS with an MPH degree. Prior experience in relevant health research projects is preferred.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Project Research Scientist - II (Non-Medical)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree with three years of post-qualification experience or a PhD in a relevant discipline to be eligible.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000/- plus 20% HRA per month, totaling approximately Rs. 80,400/- monthly.

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for the Project Research Scientist - I (Medical) post and 40 years for the Project Research Scientist - II (Non-Medical) post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for JIPMER Project Research Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on applications and CVs, followed by a written test and an in-person interview scheduled for October 22, 2026.
